summary: Vivos Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a Regulation A+ best-efforts offering: on October 30, 2026 it sold 12,500,000 common shares for $1,000,000 gross (implying $0.08 per share), plus 25,000,000 warrants at $0.075 exercise expiring December 31, 2030, sold for $25,000 to accredited investors under Regulation D. It also issued 8,000,000 shares to cancel 8,000,000 warrants under Sections 3(a)(9)/4(2). Item 5.08 sets the 2026 annual meeting for December 9, 2026, record date November 2, 2026. Watch dilution and warrant overhang; proceeds fund working capital.
